title: Signature: Feedback loop
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): analyst verdicts on alerts feed back into the detector: confirmed attacks tune sensitivity up, false positives tune it down per pattern. The loop is measured: precision and recall per pattern, tracked over time. Detectors that do not learn are retired. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers analyst verdicts tuning sensitivity.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: (8, 2), 2: (5, 5), 3: (9, 0)}
tp, fp = CFG[LEVEL]
precision = tp / (tp + fp)
print("true positives:", tp, "false positives:", fp, "| precision %.2f" % precision, "->", "tune up" if precision > 0.8 else "tune down")

title: Signature: Abuse cost meter
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): incidents are costed: compute burned, data exposed, analyst hours, and user impact. Costs prioritize response and justify defenses in budget terms. The meter runs per incident and in aggregate per quarter. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers per-incident cost breakdowns.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"compute": 50, "analyst_h": 2}, 2: {"compute": 5000, "analyst_h": 40}, 3: {"compute": 200, "analyst_h": 8, "records": 10000}}
c = CFG[LEVEL]
total = c.get("compute", 0) + c.get("analyst_h", 0) * 150 + c.get("records", 0) * 0.5
print("incident cost: $%.0f" % total, "| breakdown:", c)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.
